turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Royal Highness, I presume you have come to me in desperation, for you have no other choice. The matter at hand is too great for you to handle alone.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand the gravity of the situation. My reputation, nay, the future of Europe itself hangs in the balance, and I have no other recourse but to entrust this matter to your exceptional abilities.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that we are both intrigued and perplexed by your request. Pray, tell us more about the situation that has brought you to us in such secrecy.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear I must tread with caution, gentlemen. My situation is of the utmost gravity, and I dare not reveal too much, lest it fall into the wrong hands.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I have no interest in the machinations of European politics, Count Von Kramm. Pray tell, what is the specific nature of your concern?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, Mr. Holmes, that my concerns are of a most...sensitive nature. I fear that my situation may be...inextricably linked to the larger machinations of European politics, and I implore your discretion in this matter.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I can assure you, Count, that my discretion is absolute. Please, proceed with your explanation, and let us see if I can unravel the threads of this complex situation.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: May I suggest, Your Majesty, that we have your explanation on record, in case the details require clarification in the future?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I'll take care of recording the details, Watson. Now, Count Von Kramm, please proceed with your explanation.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that my situation is... precarious. My safety, as well as that of my kingdom, hangs in the balance, and I fear that I may be running out of time.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must say that I'm intrigued by the gravity of your situation. May I ask what specific circumstances have led to this precarious state?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that I may be placing you both in a difficult position, gentlemen, by sharing this confidence, but I must stress the gravity of the situation, and the potential consequences of its being made public.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that your words have piqued my interest. Pray, tell me, what is the nature of this confidence that you wish to share with me?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that if this matter becomes public, it may have far-reaching consequences, not only for my kingdom, but for the balance of power in Europe.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I am intrigued by the gravity of the situation. Pray tell, what is the nature of this matter that requires such confidentiality?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I dare not reveal too much at this juncture, Mr. Holmes, but rest assured that my position and the future of my kingdom hang precariously in the balance.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I am all the more intrigued by your visit now that you have mentioned the future of your kingdom. Might I inquire as to the nature of the peril that threatens it?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear, gentlemen, that the situation is... complicated. The threat to my kingdom is not merely a matter of internal strife, but also one of... international intrigue.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Pray tell, Your Majesty, what evidence do you have to suggest international intrigue is at play?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, I am at a loss for words to describe the situation, but I fear for the stability of Europe if my suspicions are correct

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
